title: Experimental Worldgen
description: Yet another data pack that adds biome variants to the game.
body:
# Experimental Worldgen

A WIP custom world generation data pack I made for fun.

## Notes
- Do not use this data pack on an existing world, you must either reset your world first, or create a new one.
- If you want to find biomes with this data pack, use jacobsjo's [Minecraft Datapack Map](https://map.jacobsjo.eu/)

## Features
- A brand new biome (Autumn forest)
- Several new biome variants like deep warm ocean, snowy old growth taigas, and more.
